claims: Ibiza is a Spanish Mediterranean island.
Ibiza is officially known as Eivissa in Catalan.
Ibiza is part of the Balearic Islands.
Dalt Vila is a UNESCO-recognized old town on Ibiza.
Dalt Vila is Upper Town in Ibiza Town.
Dalt Vila features the Castillo de la Almudaina.
Pacha is a superclub on Ibiza.
Amnesia is a superclub on Ibiza.
Hï Ibiza is a superclub on Ibiza.
Ushuaïa is a day-party venue on Ibiza.
Cafe del Mar is a sunset bar in San Antonio on Ibiza.
The official languages of Ibiza are Catalan and Spanish.
The Balearic Islands are in the Mediterranean Sea
